subject: pharmacology
title: Antivirals: Acyclovir Family, Influenza and Hepatitis Agents, Sofosbuvir, Tenofovir and Newer Drugs

steps.tx: **Acyclovir** is selective by two locks: herpesvirus thymidine kinase phosphorylates it a hundred fold faster than host enzymes, and viral DNA polymerase prefers the triphosphate, which chain terminates without a 3 prime hydroxyl. **Valacyclovir**, its valine ester prodrug, triples oral bioavailability for zoster and suppression dosing. Resistance by thymidine kinase mutation in immunocompromised hosts sends foscarnet in as the kinase independent rescue.
steps.say: Acyclovir wakes only inside herpes infected cells and stops their DNA mid sentence.

vis.alt: HSV latency and acyclovir action diagram showing viral thymidine kinase activation
vis.caption: HSV latency and acyclovir activation by viral thymidine kinase, the selectivity engine of this family.

steps.tx: **Ganciclovir** extends the nucleoside to cytomegalovirus (phosphorylated by viral UL97 kinase), owning CMV retinitis, colitis and pneumonitis treatment and transplant prophylaxis at marrow's expense (neutropenia its dose limiter, zidovudine combination forbidden fruit), while **valganciclovir** oralises it. **Foscarnet** blocks polymerase pyrophosphate exchange directly (no kinase needed, TK resistant herpes and CMV covered) billing kidneys and calcium, and **cidofovir** arrives pre phosphorylated with probenecid and saline bodyguards against its nephrotoxicity.
steps.say: Ganciclovir treats CMV and taxes marrow; foscarnet and cidofovir rescue resistance and tax kidneys.

left.title: CMV armamentarium
points: Valganciclovir oral and ganciclovir IV: first line
Neutropenia dose limiting, counts monitored
Prophylaxis in transplant risk strata
Maribavir and letermovir: modern niches

right.title: Rescue agents
points: Foscarnet: kinase independent, nephro and calcium toxic
Cidofovir: weekly, probenecid and saline escorted
Resistance guided switching by genotype
Ophthalmology and viral load surveillance

steps.tx: Influenza antivirals race replication's 48 hour peak: **oseltamivir** (oral neuraminidase inhibitor, five days treatment, prophylaxis dosing) and **zanamivir** (inhaled, asthma cautioned) block viral release, while **baloxavir** caps the polymerase acidic endonuclease in a single dose with resistance (I38 substitutions) watched. **Amantadine** from the Parkinson lessons retired here by universal M2 resistance, a resistance obituary examinations keep current.
steps.say: Neuraminidase inhibitors free trapped virus badly and baloxavir stops its copying once; amantadine has left the building.

vis.alt: Antiviral drug cellular action targets diagram for herpes, hepatitis, influenza and COVID drugs
vis.caption: Antiviral targets across herpes, hepatitis, influenza and COVID agents in this and the HIV lessons.

steps.tx: **Ribavirin**, a guanosine analogue with promiscuous mechanisms, survives in aerosolised RSV history, hepatitis C legacy combinations and viral haemorrhagic fever protocols, billing haemolytic anaemia in grams and absolute teratogenicity with six month contraception both sexes after exposure. Its breadth is its examination charm and its bedside burden, and interferon alpha beside it (next) built the pre 2014 hepatitis world both have now vacated.
steps.say: Ribavirin haemolyses and teratogenises; six months of contraception outlive its last dose.

left.title: Ribavirin niches
points: Severe RSV in defined immunocompromised hosts
Lassa and haemorrhagic fever protocols
Hepatitis C historical combinations
Inhaled and oral forms by indication

right.title: Ribavirin burdens
points: Dose dependent haemolytic anaemia
Teratogenicity: two contraceptive methods, both sexes
Six month washout after exposure
Thyroid and psychiatric effects with interferon history

steps.tx: Hepatitis C was cured pharmacologically in a decade: **sofosbuvir** (NS5B nucleotide polymerase inhibitor, pangenotypic backbone) plus NS5A inhibitors **ledipasvir** or **velpatasvir** (the latter pangenotypic in sofosbuvir velpatasvir single tablets) cure over 95 percent in eight to twelve weeks, with HBV reactivation screening before starting and amiodarone bradycardia interaction as the famous traps. Interferon alpha's flu, marrow, thyroid and depression ledger is now the control arm of history.
steps.say: Sofosbuvir plus an NS5A partner cures hepatitis C in twelve weeks; screen hepatitis B first.

nodes.label: HCV confirmed, fibrosis and HBV screen completed
Sofosbuvir based pangenotypic regimen 8 to 12 weeks
Sustained virological response checked at 12 weeks post

steps.tx: Hepatitis B is suppressed, not yet cured: **tenofovir** (disoproxil or alafenamide fumarates) and **entecavir** (potent nucleoside in treatment naive patients) hold viral loads undetectable with resistance barriers lamivudine never had, while interferon alpha offers finite courses for selected patients chasing surface antigen loss. Stopping rules are specialist territory because flares after cessation can decompensate cirrhosis, and tenofovir doubles as HIV backbone in the next lessons with renal and bone accounting attached.
steps.say: Tenofovir and entecavir suppress hepatitis B indefinitely; stopping is a specialist decision with flare risk.

left.title: HBV suppression
points: Tenofovir (TDF or TAF) or entecavir first line
High resistance barriers, indefinite therapy usual
Renal and bone monitoring by tenofovir form
Surface antigen loss uncommon, celebrated

right.title: Interferon alpha legacy
points: Finite courses, selected non cirrhotic patients
Flu like, marrow, thyroid and mood toxicities
Surface antigen loss highest with interferon
Largely historical beside direct antivirals

steps.tx: COVID antivirals divided by timing: **remdesivir** (intravenous nucleotide polymerase inhibitor, early inpatient and three day outpatient courses) and **nirmatrelvir** ritonavir (Paxlovid, oral protease inhibition within five days, its ritonavir boosting importing the HIV lesson's interaction empire wholesale into general practice), with molnupiravir behind efficacy and mutagenesis fences. Early administration is the whole pharmacology; late antivirals chase a fire already inflammatory.
steps.say: COVID antivirals are a five day race; ritonavir's interactions run the Paxlovid consultation.

left.title: Early outpatient window
points: Nirmatrelvir ritonavir within 5 days of symptoms
Interaction audit before the first dose
Three day remdesivir infusion alternative
Molnupiravir behind efficacy and pregnancy fences

right.title: Hospital territory
points: Remdesivir in oxygen requiring early disease
Immunomodulators own the later inflammatory phase
Thromboprophylaxis protocols accompany
Antivirals late alone do not rescue

steps.tx: **Acyclovir's practical liturgy** closes the lesson: intravenous hydration and infusion rates against crystal nephropathy, neurotoxicity in renal accumulation mimicking encephalitis it treats (the cruellest differential), dosing by ideal body weight and renal bands, and herpes encephalitis empiricism that never waits for PCR confirmation because hours cost neurons. Suppressive therapy transforms genital herpes recurrence and HSV prophylaxis in immunosuppression into once or twice daily quiet.
steps.say: Hydrate, dose by kidney, never wait for PCR in encephalitis; acyclovir toxicity can impersonate its indication.

nodes.label: Intravenous acyclovir started immediately with fluids
CSF PCR and imaging follow, never precede
Renal function and neurology reviewed daily
